message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel line chart comparing SelfMem BEAM scores across refinement iterations and training-set sizes.","description":"The chart is titled “SelfMem strategy optimization across iterations and training set sizes.” Both panels plot official BEAM score on a vertical scale of about 0.44–0.52. Panel A plots optimizer iterations 0–8; Panel B plots training conversations used, 1–9. In each panel, a purple triangle line shows the best observed score, while a blue line with circular markers in A and a teal-green line with circular markers in B show the average. A pale shaded band denotes the observed range. Horizontal dashed references mark the final agent strategy at 0.497 (green) and the Iter0 reference at 0.472 (gray). A black star identifies the best-observed strategy: at iteration 3 with score 0.510 in A, and at training size 6 with score 0.510 in B; both peaks are called out with labels. In A, the best-observed line starts near the Iter0 reference, rises sharply to its peak at iteration 3, then settles around 0.493–0.497; the average fluctuates more narrowly around 0.47–0.48. In B, the best-observed line peaks at training size 6 and falls to about 0.480 at size 9, while the average stays near 0.47–0.48 and finishes around the Iter0 reference.
